ops.title: Supervisor (2f) authored — gid-mechanism correction + mount syntax verified
ops.body:
Phase 2f host supervisor DRAFTED (uncommitted in the working tree, not brought up). Corrects/extends [[Container sandbox-chain host launch + supervisor (2f) open decisions]].

## Files (working tree, review + commit pending)
- `scripts/host/container-hermes.sh` (new) — one supervision tick: idempotently asserts `container system start` (status-gated) → socktainer (pgrep→relaunch→wait socket) → hermes-docker-proxy (pgrep→relaunch with 3 env vars→wait socket→verify socket gid==1000, die on drift) → `hermes` container (running→done / stopped→rm+fresh run / absent→run) with --cap-add NET_ADMIN, 2 state + 4 secret mounts + proxy-socket mount, default NAT (no --network). @@TOKEN@@-baked like host-pf.sh; user-dir last-ok marker.
- `scripts/lib/launchd.sh` — added `write_container_agent()` (com.yclaw.container-hermes gui LaunchAgent, resident backoff-then-|| true KeepAlive loop; plist only, not loaded).
- `scripts/setup.sh` — added `setup_host_container()` + `host-container` dispatch: go-builds the proxy, stages the 4 secrets into state/hosts/hermes, creates the gid-1000 group + socket dir + installs the baked tick, calls write_container_agent. bash -n + shellcheck clean on all three.

## CORRECTION to sandbox-chain note's Decision #1/#3 (gid-1000)
Achieved via a **setgid directory**, NOT a process primary-gid. Socket dir = owner login-user, group `hermes-agent`(gid 1000), mode **2750 setgid** → the proxy's 0660 listen socket inherits gid 1000 by BSD create-time group inheritance. A gid-1000 primary group is impossible for a non-root gui agent; a root:0710 dir would block the non-root proxy from binding. Tick guards with `stat -f %g` (dies on drift).

## Resolved + verified
- **Proxy provisioning**: host has Go 1.26.1, proxy is pure-stdlib CGO-free → `CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o ~/.yclaw/bin/hermes-docker-proxy .` (no nix).
- **Mount syntax VERIFIED live**: `container run --volume <file>:<tgt>:ro` supports file bind-mounts and enforces :ro (write → "Read-only file system"). The 4-secret-mount invocation is valid.

## Open-item dispositions (fable triage of the author's 9)
- #3 apiserver status-gate KEPT (blind always-`container system start` has disruption risk); helper-proc-death edge (network-vmnet/machine-apiserver/core-images die while apiserver lives) = Phase 3 live-verify item.
- #4 APPLY stale-socket cleanup (`rm -f ~/.socktainer/container.sock`) before a socktainer relaunch — the pgrep+socket-wait can pass on a lingering socket. (pending edit)
- #5 rm+fresh-run on a crashed container KEPT (restart must use current image/config); optional `container logs` dump before rm.
- #9 NAT egress is WIDE OPEN until the pf piece (2e) lands — the container must NOT carry real traffic until 2e is installed+tested (still UNPROVEN). Phase ordering constraint.

## Gated bring-up (USER, Terminal.app)
`bash scripts/setup.sh host-container` (login user, ONE sudo prompt: dscl group + /usr/local/lib/yclaw install + socket-dir chgrp), then the gui-launchd load. Pf (2e) install + live test still ahead.
